name: Park Hyatt Changsha
positioning: High-rise city hotel on the top floors of Changsha IFS Tower 2, with city and Xiang River views and Hunan-inspired interiors
best_for: Travelers who want a high-floor base with city and river views inside a shopping and dining complex
Guests interested in Hunan cuisine and private dining

facts.text: The hotel occupies the top floors of Changsha IFS Tower 2.
The hotel is within Changsha IFS, a hub for shopping, dining and entertainment.
The hotel's design integrates traditional Xiang elements and artworks.
Rooms have Le Labo bath amenities and a Nespresso coffee maker.
Lilan, the hotel's all-day dining restaurant, is on Level 62.
Lilan Bar has city and river views and serves champagne, premium wines and spirits, and cocktails by its mixologists.
The 24-hour fitness center has cardio and weight-training equipment plus a steam room, sauna, yoga studio and lounge.
The indoor pool has floor-to-ceiling windows, with natural light by day and city views at night.
Self-parking is free for hotel guests.
Hunan Museum is 2.59 kilometers from the hotel.

highlights.text: Rooms and suites have panoramic views of the city and Xiang River, starting from the 54th floor.
Lilan has eight private dining rooms seating up to 20 guests, where the chef prepares signature dishes in front of guests.
Lilan's a la carte lunch and dinner menus present authentic Hunan cuisine prepared with locally sourced ingredients.
Room interiors use natural materials and earthy tones inspired by the Hunan landscape, with statement furniture pieces and custom art.
The Garden Pavilion event space has a show kitchen and a lawn and garden suited to outdoor wedding ceremonies.

considerations.text: Changsha Huanghua International Airport is 26 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
WhataHotel notes the city-center location suits urban explorers more than those seeking resort-style surroundings.
